items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: The interviewee confirms the name 'With Dave Brubeck, yeah' but does not describe any personal interaction, collaboration, or relationship with Dave Brubeck himself. The subsequent conversation shifts to discussing other musicians (Counts of Rhythm, Joe's bassist).

ctx.x: With Dave Brubeck, yeah. And we had the Counts of Rhythm, they were out of Wendell Phillips, and there was also a couple of white bands. What’s his name that used to be with Joe? Joe talked about him all of the time?
